analysis.question: When VIX spikes above 40, what happens to it over the following quarter?

event_definition.clustering: first_day_of_episode — a spike episode begins on the first trading day VIX closes above 40 after having been at or below 40 the prior day; consecutive days above 40 are part of the same episode

statistics: mean_decay_pct (% change from spike day to 63 trading days after)
max_drawdown_from_spike (largest peak-to-trough decline in VIX within the 63-day window, measured from the spike-day level)
median_days_below_30 (median trading days until VIX first closes below 30)
pct_below_25_by_quarter_end (fraction of episodes where VIX < 25 at day 63)

quality_gates.golden_access: verification only — never read golden values during implementation; compute results independently, then verify
